title: Agent Invocation Invoke Command (interactive lane)
description: Interactive-lane twin of bloodbank.agent.invocation.start: the same data payload, delivered on its own durable consumer with reserved slots so a command a human is waiting on (a voice memo, a chat nudge) starts within seconds even while the batch lane is saturated. Producers publish this envelope on bloodbank.cmd.agent.invocation.invoke; the Hermes gateway dispatches using data.target_agent_id and emits the same agent.invocation.started/completed/failed lifecycle facts as the batch lane. Use ONLY when a human is waiting; unattended work stays on invocation.start. See docs/interactive-command-lane.md.

target_agent_id.description: Routing key identifying which agent should execute the invocation.

thread_id.description: Optional existing thread identifier for continuation.

prompt.description: Prompt/content for the target agent to execute.

context.description: Optional structured context for the target agent invocation.

deadline_seconds.description: Optional wall-clock budget for the turn, in seconds. A lane that enforces a per-turn timeout (the interactive lane does, 300 s by default; the batch lane only when configured) stops the Hermes turn after min(this, the lane's turn_timeout_seconds) and publishes bloodbank.agent.invocation.failed with error_code turn_timeout. It can only shorten the lane limit, never extend it; a lane with no timeout ignores it.

model.description: Optional model route for THIS turn only, e.g. automaticai/auto/fast or automaticai/personal/claude-sonnet-5.5. The Hermes gateway applies it with Hermes' own `/model <route> --once` on the command's session just before dispatch: the session runs this one turn on the route and returns to the profile's model when the turn ends (never written to config). One token: no whitespace, not starting with - or /. Best effort: an unknown or unlisted route, a busy session or a slow switch leaves the turn on the profile's model, and the terminal fact's model_override {requested, applied, reason} says what happened. Effort is not a separate field: on automaticai/auto* routes the AutomaticAI gateway picks the effort from the route's rung, and an explicit route takes the effort its providers entry sets.
